name: Azure Craft | Solo Crafteling | MineKart
description:
Heroz Network is three gamemodes built from scratch, each with custom 3D models, animations and its own resource pack. No copy-paste plugins.

AZURE CRAFT: Blue Lock football

- A real physics ball: shoot, pass, dribble, flick and tackle

- 7 styles (Isagi, Chigiri, Sae, Kaiser, Kurona and more), each with its own moves

- Flow mode, with full anime cutscenes

- Servers in Europe, the US and Oceania for low ping

SOLO CRAFTELING: Solo Leveling survival RPG

- Level up your Hunter, raise your stats and unlock skills

- Clear Gates: themed dungeons with modelled bosses

- Kill, then ARISE: build your own shadow army

- Dungeon breaks, the Demon King's Castle, daily quests and the Penalty Zone

MINEKART: kart racing

- Drifting, mini-turbos and tricks

- Items: shells, bananas, mushrooms, lightning and more

- 20 tracks, with CPU racers to fill the grid

Java and Bedrock (phone, console, PC) can play together. New content arrives regularly.
